source_contract.cache: Inherited auto cache wrapper recovers before update; played misses capture whole input; paused misses cache retained output, initially source noone=-4. Animated updates scheduling on an actual miss only.
source_contract.cache_array: Start<0 maps to0, otherwise Start-1; Stop<0 maps toTOTAL_FRAMES. Invalid range uses stop<start, so equality is not invalid but cannot capture. Only played in-range observations capture. Capture every observed frame regardless Step; Step selects published positions with -1 for absent frames. Other observations retain exact previous output.
source_contract.metadata: Explicit attri.serialize bool, attri.cache_group string list and top-level cache string are roundtripped without synthetic absent fields. Constructor defaults serialize=true, empty group.
source_contract.surface_cloning: Native snapshots preserve finite bounded CPU surface formats and recursive input shape. No device handle identity, live GPU surface alias or licensed GPU clone parity claim.

native_profile.observation: Optional by-value SourceCachePlaybackObservation with explicit Playing, ObservedFrame or NativePlayedPrefix and SynchronousProducer attestation. RigidPlaying is independent.
native_profile.observed_frame: Capture only actual observations. Pure data seeks directly; mixed noncontiguous nonzero seeks diagnose missing recorded scheduler. Same-clock Playing refresh retains current latest cache output/history and restores other frame-start journals.
native_profile.played_prefix: Caller explicitly chooses Playing=true for each admitted native prefix frame. Seeks rebuild latest-output observation from constructor while retaining frame captures. Fresh seeks create the bounded played prefix.
native_profile.ownership: DataReplay tagged node/processor rows own latest output separately from sorted frame snapshots. Preserve history across authored control revisions/restart; remove/type-change retires rows. Whole owner Clear resets them. PB retains observation by value, never caller pointers.
native_profile.storage: Integer nonnegative frames only; timeline storage capped at4094 frames plus private tag/output records, array selections4096; whole evaluation byte/work limits apply with generation overlap charged.
native_profile.unsupported: Serialized loading and enabled nonempty source cache groups require actual host scheduler/captures and diagnose. Selected Cache/Clear Cache buttons and freed GPU-handle lifecycle remain separate unimplemented source scheduler work.
